description: Returns one NHTSA recall campaign by its campaign number (e.g. 20V314000, 20V-314 or 23C001): manufacturer, report date, component, summary, consequence, remedy, potential number of units affected, advisories, and the makes, models and model years it covers. Works for vehicle (V), equipment (E), tire (T) and child seat (C) campaigns.

detail.description: "brief" (default) keeps each result short; "full" adds the complete text fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of make/model entries to list (1-200, default 40).

name: vehicle_recall_campaign
title: NHTSA recall campaign details
